personal.bio: Full Stack Software Engineer building high-performance web and mobile applications. Specialized in React, Next.js, Node.js, and cross-platform React Native apps. Also providing complete ICT solutions and technical troubleshooting.
detailedBio: I specialize in building full-stack web applications and cross-platform mobile apps. With expertise in React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, and React Native, I craft complete digital products — from pixel-perfect frontends to robust, scalable backends.

My journey began with a strong foundation in Software Engineering from Mizan-Tepi University, where I graduated with distinction (3.74/4.00 CGPA). Since then, I've built enterprise systems, e-commerce platforms, and ticketing applications used in real-world scenarios.

Whether it's a responsive web application, a cross-platform mobile app, or troubleshooting a complex ICT problem, I focus on delivering clean, production-ready solutions that solve real business challenges.

exp1.description: On-site software engineering internship engineering a scalable enterprise CMS with React.js and Node.js/Express.js.

Implemented JWT authentication and granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Built full CRUD workflows for strict data security and administrative integrity
Designed modular API routes integrated with cloud/database persistence
Streamlined digital asset management, content publishing, and audit logging

exp2.description: Architected and built a complete end-to-end ticketing platform with real-time seat reservations and secure authentication.
achievements: Built full ticketing web app with React.js + TypeScript frontend and Node.js/Express.js backend
Engineered interactive real-time seat reservation interface and responsive seating map
Designed optimized database schemas for showtime schedules and user bookings
Optimized queries and caching to support 15% growth in transaction volume
Deployed frontend on Vercel and backend REST API on Render
